title: Budget-specific configuration results
caption: Internal rows share a checkpoint, hardware and a 10,000-item evaluation set.

context.purpose: A publication layout example, not real performance claims
context.comparison: Internal rows use the same checkpoint, evaluation set of 10000 items and hardware; inference-token ceilings differ across budget blocks. External reference uses a different evaluation harness and is for context only.

units.p95_latency_ms: milliseconds, smaller is better; within-run quantile, no interval claim

missingness.OOM: execution ran out of memory under this configuration

context.precision: One decimal in every numeric column

provenance.intended_claim: The synthetic data illustrate budget-specific quality and latency comparisons while preserving displayed ties, missing results and execution failures.

comparison_contract.internal_16k: Same checkpoint, evaluation set and hardware; 16k inference-token ceiling.
comparison_contract.internal_32k: Same checkpoint, evaluation set and hardware; 32k inference-token ceiling.
comparison_contract.external: Different evaluation harness; background context only; rank false.

provenance.rounding: Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP, one decimal in every numeric result column. Raw decimal strings retained. Ranking compares displayed values.
provenance.uncertainty: No replication or confidence interval information available. P95 is a within-run quantile, not an interval.
provenance.calculations: No new scores, aggregates, intervals or deltas calculated. Only display rounding and within-budget optimum selection.
